name: s03-sheetA
refs: The signed young S03, Tuikis (project-owned): THE individual in every panel, exactly: round bear-like ears, a thin antenna-like crest with a small bead tip rising from the top of the head, big wide-set teal eyes with pale rims, a lagoon-teal head and back with cream patches, a pale milk-mint blue-white body with teal patches, pale rounded paws, a thin tail ending in a small yellow bulb.
The same individual, cut out (front-left three-quarter): the body, coat, pattern and crest to follow in every panel.
prompt: Paint SIX equal SQUARE panels in a 3 by 2 grid with a small gap of plain magenta between them. Each panel is a close-up of one part, centred and filling its panel, lit from the top left. TOP ROW: A1 'colour, lagoon': the flank's coat, showing the lagoon teal ground colour across the body. A2 'trim, milk-mint': the underside and throat, where the pale milk-mint trim colour lies. A3 'eyes, big and wide': the face from the front with its two big wide-set eyes, the crest and both round ears in view. BOTTOM ROW: A4 'snout, between': the head in three-quarter view, the crest and ears in view, the snout of middle length and breadth. A5 'build, between': the whole body from the side, of middle bulk, tail included. A6 'haunch, between': the hind body with its haunch of middle fullness and the base of the tail. The creature is the SAME individual as in the references in every panel (its own body, coat, pattern, round ears, thin antenna crest with its bead tip, and tail with its yellow bulb); no other individual, no new features. Soft painterly brush and light from the top left as the references. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background everywhere, no borders, no dividing lines, no text, no numbers, no labels, no glow, no hands, no people.
